definitions.explanation: One of the four pointed teeth between the incisors and the premolars.

examples.japanese: {犬歯|けんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧きた。
examples.english: Her canine teeth have come in.

examples.japanese: {犬歯|けんし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上下|じょうげ}→上下：04282_jouge⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二本|にほん}⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are two canines in the upper jaw and two in the lower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{出|で}た{犬歯|けんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{八重歯|やえば}→八重歯：32477_yaeba⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}び→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧、⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan a canine that sticks out is called a yaeba, and some people find it cute.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {糸切|いとき}り{歯|ば}: the everyday name for a canine (literally, the thread-cutting tooth)
- ⟦{八重歯|やえば}→八重歯：32477_yaeba⟧: a canine that grows out of line
- ⟦{牙|きば}→牙：16154_kiba⟧: a fang or tusk, of animals

WATCH OUT:
- Same reading as ⟦{剣士|けんし}→剣士：11912_kenshi⟧ (swordsman) and ⟦{検死|けんし}→検死：19209_kenshi⟧ (autopsy).
